error_page_unreadable: Olupapula luno terusobola kusomebwa. Empapula za browser ne Chrome Web Store tebiwagirwa.
error_no_content: Tewali bigambo bya lupapula ebizuuliddwa ku lupapula luno.
error_needs_click: Nyiga akabonero k'ekyongerezo okufunza olupapula luno. Ttabu bw'egenda ku lupapula olulala, ekyongerezo kyetaaga okunyigibwa omulundi omulala okulusoma.
error_host_missing: Ekitundu eky'omu kompyuta tekiteekeddwamu oba tekiddamu. Mu folda y'ekyongerezo, dduka: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: Claude Code tezuuliddwa. Giteekemu, oluvannyuma dduka ./native-host/install.sh nate.
error_claude_auth: Toyingidde mu Claude Code. Dduka claude mu terminal oyingire.
error_codex_signed_out: Toyingidde mu Codex. Dduka codex login mu terminal.
error_codex_not_eligible: Enteekateeka yo eya ChatGPT tesobola kukozesebwa ku kino. Londa omugabi omulala.
error_usage_limit: Otuuse ku kkomo ly'okukozesa enteekateeka yo. Gezaako oluvannyuma oba londa omugabi omulala.
error_provider_failed: Omugabi alemereddwa ng'awandiika ebifunze. Gezaako nate.
error_codex_missing: Codex tezuuliddwa. Giteekemu, oluvannyuma dduka ./native-host/install.sh nate.
options_help: Ebifunze biyita mu kitundu eky'omu kompyuta eno: kidduka Claude Code oba Codex nga kikozesa okwewandiisa kwo, oba model mu Ollama. Ebigambo by'olupapula biweerezebwa wa mugabi gw'olonze yekka.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama tekola ku kompyuta eno. Giteekemu okuva ku ollama.com ogiggule, oluvannyuma ogezeeko nate.
error_ollama_model_missing: Model eno tennawanulibwa mu Ollama. Dduka ollama pull n'erinnya lya model (okugeza, ollama pull llama3.2), oluvannyuma ogezeeko nate.
options_models_auto: Zivva mu Claude Code, Codex ne Ollama, era zisomebwa nate omulundi gumu buli lunaku, nga Claude Code oba Codex bizzibwa obuggya, era nga extension ezzibwa obuggya.
error_file_access: Okufunza mu bufunze fayiro eziri ku kompyuta eno, ggulawo Details z'ekyongerwako mu chrome://extensions era otandike Allow access to file URLs.
error_pdf_unreadable: PDF eno tesobola kuggulwawo. Eyinza okuba ng'ekuumibwa n'ekigambo ky'okuyingira oba eyonoonese.
error_pdf_no_text: PDF eno terina bigambo bya kufunza. Eyinza okuba ng'ekoleddwa mu bifaananyi ebisikaanidwa.
history_empty: Tewannabaawo bifunze. Bijja kulabika wano ng'obikola.
error_no_transcript: Vidiyo eno terina bigambo biwandiikiddwa bya kufunza. YouTube ebiba nabyo wokka nga vidiyo erina ebiwandiiko wansi oba ebiwandiiko ebyekola byokka.
options_styles_help: Engeri eyongera ekiragiro ku bifunze, okugeza: Kifunze ng'olukalala lw'obubaka busatu obumpi.
